Guantao Daqi owns the retained address: point and you don't arrive, arrive and you don't point — Huangmei's waist-dropping stone moss-grown, master Touzi barefoot to Tongcheng, the copper sieve brimming with oil — how to tell the host? Senses.Explanation: The point-and-never-arrive of the Chan records: the blocked road — the newcomer shouted down, the bamboo and peach-blossom awakenings ruled past pointing, the Shaolin message, the reunion without expedients, and the whisk-flick on say-and-don't-say. Xuedou Chongxian tests the six newcomers: any author-masters of Chan here? The leader: what does the abbot say? — Point and you don't arrive. The monk goes to deliberate — a shout. Silence. Dragon head, snake tail. The second, asked why he doesn't answer for the leader — one slap. The third, blank — one charge-sheet covers all, Hongzhi Zhengjue weighs the famous awakenings: everyone says Xiangyan struck the bamboo and his mind brightened, Lingyun saw the peach blossoms and woke — was it really so? At that time, arrive and it wasn't pointed; now, point and you don't arrive, Zhenjing Kewen takes the Shaolin-message ask — if it were so, the Shaolin tidings would be cut off, yet the traces stand plain — the monk bows — and he answers: point and you don't arrive; then his own address: the wonder of the way's teaching only returns to its source; returned to source, nothing is not allowed, all stands present, the ocean-seal giving light — now together with the assembly returned to source, dwelling in the equal basis: which is the source, which the wonder? — only because it was utterly plain, the attaining came late, and Linye Tongqi meets an old friend: formerly we met without talking Chan — today reunited, should I talk the way? Not that this mountain monk lacks expedients — only that in this matter pointing cannot arrive: propose it before the words and you're sealed in the shell; master it under the phrase and you run mad along every road. Only the out-of-rank spirit doesn't enter by either track — and the one line beyond delusion and waking? He remembers the third month of Jiangnan: where the partridge cries, a hundred flowers scent. Yikui Yuankui's evening address: lightning rolls, stars race — arrive and it isn't pointed; the moment thought stirs — point and you don't arrive. And once both ends are sat cut through, the one gate above split open: one line holding the three mysteries, one mystery holding the three essentials — what a gate! Examine it out and you're no false Shending guest of Chan; fail, and the Zhengzhou pear, the Qingzhou date — at bottom nothing beats a good provenance, Xieyun Jiji grades the Qinshan-Yantou brothers: they turned the grandfather's resounding family name into wind-flowers-snow-moon — striking in with his own verse: born on the same branch, their bearing differs; riding sound and covering color, what difference? Plucking the flower-branch for a wine-tally, playing wind and moon through rain and mist — point and you don't arrive: great skill seems clumsy — then the sudden staff: fallen red covers the ground with no one sweeping, all of it the traveler's eyes' blood, and Guantao Daqi's evening address: point and you don't arrive, arrive and you don't point — Huangmei's waist-dropping stone, moss-grown in wind and rain; master Touzi barefoot down to Tongcheng — what you are all used to seeing; the copper sieve brimming with oil — how do you tell the host from it? One monk bowed and walked straight out; the master: hearing the name is not like meeting the face.
